result: At 100k bars, latest-only builder measured 0.619 ms (grid) and 0.818 ms (random); native single calls measured 1.075 ms and 1.661 ms. Caller-parallelized native remained faster at 0.511 ms and 0.643 ms.
limitations: Four-worker builder is not a single-thread arithmetic win.
Full history and smaller inputs still use serial CPU execution at this stage.
Shared tensor pool initialization is excluded from steady-state timing.
Independent SMA rebuild SIMD prototype passed correctness but did not demonstrate a material end-to-end gain; production change rejected.
